artifacts.summary: Confirms Goldblatt 1989 'Varieties of Complex Algebras' (APAL 44, 173-242) is absent from both the 361-entry Literature/ corpus and Zotero (only unrelated Goldblatt items present: goldblatt_2003 = different paper, 2023 real-time completeness paper, and a 2003/2006 survey explicitly noted as a partial substitute). Bibliographically verified via the author's own VUW paper list. No legitimately fetchable copy found: not self-archived by the author (online papers only go back to ~2000), and the Semantic Scholar 'Bronze OA' ScienceDirect link returned HTTP 403 (Cloudflare bot-challenge) on every probed endpoint (curl HEAD/GET, WebFetch, DOI resolver chain). No PDF obtained, so the pdffonts/pdftotext extractability check could not be run. Reports the concrete acquisition path: institutional access, ILL, or direct author email request, plus a pre-emptive flag that any scanned copy risks the same sentence-boundary-glue quality-gate failure documented for the Gabbay 2003 task.

memory_candidates.content: Semantic Scholar's Graph API 'isOpenAccess'/'openAccessPdf.status: BRONZE' field for old Elsevier ScienceDirect articles does not reliably indicate actual fetchability: for Goldblatt 1989 APAL 44 (doi:10.1016/0168-0072(89)90032-8), every direct HTTP probe against the reported ScienceDirect PDF/article URLs and the DOI resolver chain returned HTTP 403 from a Cloudflare bot-challenge page (NOARCHIVE robots meta), both via curl (HEAD and GET with browser UA) and via the WebFetch tool. Bronze OA claims should be treated as untested until a live fetch is attempted, not as confirmation of accessibility.

For checking whether an author self-archives a specific older paper, Goldblatt's VUW-hosted 'Online Papers' list (homepages.ecs.vuw.ac.nz/~rob/papers.html) only covers roughly 2000-onward; his full bibliography with exact citations is at homepages.ecs.vuw.ac.nz/~rob/paperlist.pdf, which is useful for verifying exact title/journal/volume/page metadata even when no download link exists for a given entry.

next_steps: Blocked on user action: obtain the PDF via institutional Elsevier access, interlibrary loan, or direct request to Robert Goldblatt (VUW), then re-run /research 461 (or a fresh dispatch) to perform the pdffonts/pdftotext extractability check on the obtained copy before any ingest attempt.
